title: Subscription, limits & billing
public_subtitle: Three clear plans for time tracking, facility management, and enterprise portfolios. Try free for one month.
subtitle: After your free month, choose a plan. Limits apply per organisation for units, documents, photos and users.
plans_intro: Choose the WinProx plan that fits your organisation. Start with digital time tracking or manage your full operational workflow right away. Growing organisation? WinProx grows with you.
admin_required: Only an administrator can choose a subscription. Contact your organisation's administrator.
activated: You chose :plan. Your subscription is active for the configured period.
facility_not_included: Issues, tasks and calendar require WinProx Facility or Corporate. Upgrade your plan to unlock facility workflows.
status_legacy: Your organisation does not use trial tracking yet (legacy account). All features remain available.
status_grace: Subscription :plan ended on :ended. Grace period until :grace_end — :days days of full access left. Renew in time to avoid interruption.
status_expired: Your trial has ended. Choose a plan below to continue.
pricing_intro: WinProx includes a one-month free trial with facility and time features. After that, choose the plan that matches your organisation.
status_module_esg: ESG module active on your account.
status_module_time: Time module active on your account.
page_limits_units_body: You are using :current of :max units. "Add unit" stays disabled until you upgrade.
page_limits_locations_body: You are using :current of :max locations. "Add location" stays disabled until you upgrade.
page_limits_users_body: You are using :current of :max team seats on your plan. "Add user" is disabled until you upgrade.
page_limits_documents_body: Your organisation is using :current of :max documents. Delete a document or upgrade your plan to upload more.
page_limits_photos_body: Your organisation is using :current of :max photos. Delete photos or upgrade your plan to upload more.
legal_footer_intro: Your account is subject to, among others:

limits.warning_units: You have :remaining unit slots left in your plan.
limits.critical_units: Your unit limit is reached. Upgrade your plan to add more units.
limits.warning_users: You have :remaining user slots left in your plan.
limits.critical_users: Your user limit is reached. Upgrade your plan to invite more colleagues.

time.name: WinProx Time
time.scale: Up to 10 units/locations/documents/photos for your organisation.
time.users: Includes 1 administrator and 1 staff member. Unlimited workers via CSV/Excel import.
time.description: Unlimited QR issues and tasks within your locations and units.
features: Time module: clock in/out, breaks, shifts and QR Clock Points.

facility.name: WinProx Facility
facility.scale: Up to 100 units/locations/documents/photos for your organisation.
facility.users: Includes 1 administrator and up to 4 staff members. Unlimited workers via CSV/Excel import.
facility.description: Full facility workflows at larger scale. WinProx Time included. CSV/Excel bulk import for units and workers.
features: Unlimited QR issues and tasks within your locations and units.
IoT Connect: sensor alarms → issues (gateway ingest).

corporate.name: WinProx Corporate
features: IoT Connect + ESG measurements via sensors.

purge.title: Delete organisation data
purge.intro: Delete all data for this organisation from WinProx. This cannot be undone (media files are not kept in the recovery snapshot).
purge.export_link: Export via Settings → Privacy & data export
purge.export_ack: I have seen or downloaded the export option (Settings)
purge.trial_hint: All administrators receive a confirmation email. Only after confirming via the link can you delete. A SQL snapshot without media is created first.
purge.paid_hint: After email confirmation there is a 7-day cool-down. WinProx administration performs the deletion at the scheduled time. A SQL snapshot without media is created first.
purge.status_awaiting_email: Confirmation email sent to all administrators. Open the link in that email to confirm.
purge.status_ready: Email confirmation received. You can permanently delete the data now.
purge.status_scheduled: Data deletion will be carried out on :date (:timezone) by WinProx administration.
purge.started: Confirmation email sent to all administrators.
purge.confirm_start: Start the deletion procedure? You will receive a confirmation email.
purge.confirm_execute: Permanently delete all data? This cannot be undone.
purge.confirm_execute_superuser: Delete tenant now? A snapshot without media will be saved first.

errors.admin_only: Only an administrator can do this.
errors.export_required: Confirm that you have seen the export option.
errors.already_open: A deletion request is already open.
errors.not_awaiting_email: This request is not awaiting email confirmation.
errors.not_open: There is no open deletion request.
errors.email_not_confirmed: Confirm via the email link first.
errors.superuser_only: Only WinProx administration can perform this.
errors.too_many_password_attempts: Too many incorrect password attempts. You have been logged out. Sign in again to continue.

purge.status_scheduled_expired_trial: Without a subscription, organisation data will be automatically deleted on :date (:timezone).
purge.expired_trial_subscribe_hint: Activate a subscription to stop this, or export your data first via Settings.
